name: Uta
title: A deck for the new era featuring the irresistible power of FILM!
desc:
This is a deck made up of high-performing red and purple FILM cards, including Characters from the
ONE PIECE film archive. Take out your opponent's Characters with your Leader's [When Attacking]
effect while using DON!! cards to harness powerful high cost cards with confidence.

cards.name: Uta
cards.text: [When Attacking] You may trash 1 {FILM} type card from your hand: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn. Then, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Raise Max
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may place this Character at the bottom of the owner's deck: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Buena Festa
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {FILM} type card other than [Buena Festa] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {FILM} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Shiki
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] If you have 8 or more DON!! cards on your field, draw 1 card and trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Shuraiya
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[When Attacking]/[On Block] [Once Per Turn] This Character's base power becomes the same as your opponent's Leader until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Saga
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] This Character gains +1000 power until the start of your next turn. Then, trash 1 of your {FILM} type Characters at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Gild Tesoro
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): If your Leader has the {FILM} type, add up to 2 {FILM} type Character cards with a cost of 4 or less from your trash to your hand.

cards.name: Gild Tesoro
cards.text: [When Attacking] DON!! −2 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text: [On Play] K.O. up to 2 of your opponent's Characters with a total power of 4000 or less.

cards.name: Douglas Bullet
cards.text:
If your Leader has the {FILM} type, this Character gains [Blocker].
(After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Zephyr (Navy)
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters during this turn. Then, if that Character has 5000 power or less, K.O. it.

cards.name: Shanks
cards.text: [On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 10000 power or less.

cards.name: Radical Beam!!
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, that card gains an additional +2000 power.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.
